Rules.Power: P = recommended skill level of the area (0..120). Scene P = REGION_POWER of its city/island code (GUESS: ordered by the WEB rebuild-city ladder L1 Athens/Beirut/Alexandria/Istanbul, L2 Genoa, L3-4 Algiers, L5-6 Seville, L7-8 Hamburg, L9 Seoul, L10 Beijing, WEB_RULES.md section 5, and by sailing distance from Athens); +2 per earlier species of the same scene in client key order (max +10); +5 elite, +10 boss.
Rules.Level: Level = P // 10 (the emulator treats Level as a tier: Hit = 85 + 9*Level, Dodge = 5 + 9*Level as in rules.json Combat.MonsterHitBase/MonsterDodgeBase/MonsterRatingPerTier; Athens monsters are Level 0-1).
Rules.Stats: normal monster: Hp = 20 + 3P + 0.15P^2, Attack = 3 + 0.6P + 0.004P^2, Defence = P/4, Gold = 8 + 3P + 0.1P^2 (anchored on the hand-made Athens monsters: P 0 crab 20/3/0, P 10 goat 40-50/9/2); critter x0.6 HP/attack; elite (leader, chief, king, lord, captain, champion ...) x2.5 HP, x1.5 attack/defence, x3 gold; boss (named single target, "Kill 1 <name>", or a client boss marker) x5 HP, x2 attack/defence, x6 gold.
Rules.Behaviour: Aggressive when P >= 30 and not a critter or scarecrow; never flees (Athens monsters: passive, no flee).
Rules.Groups: normal species 4 spawns per scene (quest count >= 20: 6), elite 2, boss 1; spread over the walk mesh by farthest-point sampling at least 30 units from the scene arrival points, members within 10 units of the group centre; client marker position used as group centre when the scene has one.
Rules.Model: CLIENT when the scene preloads exactly the model the name maps to, or when the MODELNAME label of an ini\objects model is the monster name; GUESS when the name ends with such a label; otherwise GUESS from the name -> ini\objects ANIMATION keyword table (MODEL_KEYWORDS).
Rules.Client fields: Radius/Height = RADIUS/HEIGHT of ini\objects\<Model>.ini; Attacks/DieAction/DeathAction = ActGroup.ini [prior] indices whose ActionSet 0 animation (attack0_n, die0, death0) exists in animation\<ANIMATION>.ani; DieMilliseconds = die0 frames / .an frame rate. All CLIENT.
Rules.Ships: pirate ladder tier from the name (Peg Leg 1, Iron Hand/Fist 2, Steel Tooth 3, Golden Eye 4, Jackal 5, Falcon 6, Tiger 7, Skeleton 8, Devil 9, Hades 10, Scorpion 11, Terror/Scared 12, Nightmare 13 = WEB pirate title order, WEB_RULES.md section 4) else region tier; Hull/Sail/Sailors = 60% of the ships.json class of that tier (battle class for Armed/War ships, raider class for Raiding ships, merchant class for Smuggling/Cargo/Merchant ships; captains/flagships 150%); cannons per side = class cannons / 4 (min 2); cannon = balanced cannon (model 25x0001) of grade min(tier,10); armour 3*tier/2.5*tier; hit 60+2*tier; gold 150*tier + 50*tier*(tier-1); reputation 10*tier; respawn 60+30*tier s (max 300). All GUESS.
